status: Original cinematic robotic audio overhaul with the five-tier Gunsmith Bench, traveled-path damage falloff, native icons and persistent reloads.
designRules: Each weapon crafts independently; never consume a previous weapon and silently lose its enchantment metadata.
One projectile and one damage event per shot, including laser-styled tiers; no normal-shot AoE/piercing/percentage-health proc.
Cycle is shared across all nine rifles, so swapping tiers cannot bypass it.
Ranges are proposed effective shot limits, not promises about unloaded chunks.
Numbers are pre-class, pre-skill and pre-enchantment; playtest remains required.
Legendary rifles are sidegrades: equal 2.9-second normal cadence prevents shared flat bonuses and optimal True Bolts pacing from favoring a faster rifle.
Normal head damage is explicitly defined per weapon: Requiem 78/98, Dawnpiercer 52/130. The native head calculator replaces body damage once.
Legendary Q abilities share a 12-second cooldown and the common rifle recovery lock. They never add a second damage event or bypass native immunity.
Every rifle accepts exactly one exclusive ammo ID; shared Arrow tags enable Eternal Shot but are never an ammo-selection wildcard.
Source ammo.stats drives the actual generated primary damage and projectile physics; unsupported custom Item stat fields are not emitted.

Normal paired body/head damage equals receiver plus ammo exactly. Legendary Q damage remains its explicit balanced ability override; its projectile physics and two-round payment use the compatible ammo.
Legacy generic ammunition is uncraftable and unstocked; finite pre-existing units can be repacked 1:1, never used directly by a rifle.
R invokes the native reload action (Ability4, default client binding); rebindings remain client-controlled.
Loaded ammunition belongs to each rifle ItemStack, never to the shared player Ammo stat. All existing metadata and durability survive reloads.
A reload transfers matching inventory ammunition only at completion. Cancellation, swap, missing ammunition or a full chamber cannot create rounds.
Normal fire requires one loaded round; Legendary Q requires two loaded rounds. No inventory fallback bypasses the chamber.
Both Legendary rifles hold two rounds and reload in 2.7 seconds; their existing normal cadence and shared Q/recovery cooldowns remain unchanged.
Eternal Shot refunds exactly one matching inventory round per committed projectile; the rifle still requires reloading.

Every normal body/head and Legendary Q base hit uses one shared absolute-distance curve: full through35 world units, linear to65% at225, then clamped. Existing lifetime/collision travel limits still apply.
Distance is accumulated3D projectile travel from actual spawn to native impact contact, including the final partial physics segment. Shooter or target motion cannot reset it.
Falloff modifies the native selected base-damage calculator exactly once before ordinary class, enchantment and armor processing. Independent class-proc damage retains the installed mod rules.
Both Legendary rifles use the same distance multiplier at every shared distance; their body/head sidegrade and shared cooldowns remain intact.

ammo.name: Wayfinder Cartridges
ammo.description: Copper jackets and a hard iron point, made for a surveyor's first clean shot.

ammo.name: Sirocco Longshot Rounds
ammo.description: Thorium-stabilized long rounds sealed against grit. A yellow crystal primer keeps the desert charge consistent.

ammo.name: Rimeglass Match Rounds
ammo.description: Cold-worked cobalt and silver seat a finely cut match tip for the Whisperfrost watch.

ammo.name: Gravelight Reliquary Rounds
ammo.description: Bone spacers cradle a purple focus inside a dark iron case. The dead halls taught its makers to waste neither lead nor breath.

ammo.name: Gobliterator Siege Slugs
ammo.description: A solid metal penetrator rides an amber induction coil. Deepworks scrap turns the Gobliterator's own machinery into its final ammunition.

ammo.name: Firstlight Prism Cartridges
ammo.description: A white-gold cartridge encloses a violet prism and a cyan focusing lens: a measured charge for the last light of Luminia.

ammo.name: Penance Rounds
ammo.description: Dark silver braces a split metal point around an altar eye. A pinch of Moon Salt steadies the charge.

ammo.name: Threadline Sabots
ammo.description: Fullmetal plates brace a cyan crystal core, the casing etched with a path through a maze.

ammo.name: Skyglass Scout Cartridges
ammo.description: Blue crystal, copper and iron bound in red for an old sky-trader's rifle. A small green seal marks the rounds that passed the wind test.

tiers.name: Wildwood Surveyor
tiers.description: Oak and copper built for the quiet paths of the Emerald Wilds. One steady breath, one clean shot.

audio.theme: Warm oak-and-copper report, solid bolt and brass cartridge clicks.

tiers.name: Dunewatch Longshot
tiers.description: A sand-sealed long rifle assembled for the watchposts of the Howling Sands. The horizon is closer than it looks.

audio.theme: Dry thorium crack, a gritty side-bolt and a faint yellow-primer ring.

tiers.name: Frostline Sentinel
tiers.description: Silver-lined cobalt keeps this sentinel true through Whisperfrost's bitter winds. Its pale tracer cuts through the snowfall.

audio.theme: Crisp cobalt report with a restrained icy overtone and silver lock.

tiers.name: Mournhollow Epitaph
tiers.description: A reliquary key reforged into a violet focusing chamber. Below Mournhollow, every echo deserves a final word.
tiers.progressionNote: Reliquary Key drops from current Mournhollow packs/bosses; crafting deliberately consumes a key, not an old weapon. Do not claim it requires a full dungeon clear.

audio.theme: Deep sepulchral report, hollow reliquary latch and violet charge pulses.

tiers.name: Gobliterator's Requiem
tiers.description: Recovered from the wreck of the Gobliterator, this rifle carries a heart that has forgotten how to stop. Deepworks artificers meant its rail chamber to shatter gates. A patient marksman taught it a quieter purpose. Amber coils kindle around a cyan rail, the scope settles, and the stolen core begins its last hymn. Then comes a single iron verdict, followed by a long, rattling breath while the chamber cools. The last sound of the Deepworks belongs to whoever holds this weapon.
tiers.progressionNote: Gobliterator core is guaranteed one per native Gobliterator kill; this is a real Deepworks completion gate.
tiers.glowTheme: Amber reactor coils, cyan rail energy, small industrial arcs and warm held light.
tiers.role: Heavy body-shot rifle, economical reactor, close/mid-range control
tradeoffs: Higher body damage and body-shot ammo efficiency
Shorter range and lower scope magnification
Reactor Break takes a one-second charge and a long firing recovery

audio.theme: Dense steel-and-coil rail clap, heavy slug feed and amber capacitor prime.

tiers.name: Dawnpiercer, Last Light of Luminia
tiers.description: Three shattered seals sleep within a lattice of Prisma. When their fragments align, white-gold runes awaken along the stock and a violet star gathers behind the lens. Luminian wardens are said to have carried such lights when the sanctums fell silent, saving each brilliant shot for the shape at the far end of the dark. This remnant answers the same oath: hold fast, choose the moment, and let a single ray speak. Between shots, its crystal hums like dawn remembered beneath stone.
tiers.progressionNote: Three seal fragments are guaranteed from the Hollow Warden, Luminian Sentinel, and Seal Herald respectively; requires revisiting those bosses if seals were spent on the gateway.
tiers.glowTheme: White-gold and cyan energy channels, violet crystal motes and cool held light.
tiers.role: Long-range weak-point rifle and cooperative spotter
tradeoffs: Higher headshot damage and longer sightline range
Substantially lower body damage and body-shot ammo efficiency
Radiant Brand spends two cells on a low-damage setup shot
Boss slow immunity is preserved; mark remains visual only on those targets

audio.theme: Focused prism discharge, clean glass alignment and a bright white-gold resonance.

tiers.name: Nameless Covenant
tiers.description: A dark-silver covenant struck at the Nameless God's altar. The caged eye holds its gaze until the chamber falls silent.
tiers.acquisition: Craft at Mjolnir's Furnace tier 2, barter at the Nameless God tier 2, or buy from the Devil Merchant.
tiers.progressionNote: Independent recipes consume materials/currency and never an existing enchanted rifle.

audio.theme: Dark-silver thump, hollow cage latch and a tense violet fifth.

tiers.name: Labyrinth Threadkeeper
tiers.description: Chrome ribs guard a cyan thread through the Labyrinth's black halls. Trace the line, hold your breath, and make the way clear.
tiers.acquisition: Craft at the Blacksmith's Anvil tier 3 using Fullmetal materials.
tiers.progressionNote: Fullmetal ore also has an Arcanist bench recipe. This is a regional material theme, not proof of a Labyrinth clear.

audio.theme: Machined sabot snap, chrome breech and a short cyan induction zip.

tiers.name: Skybound Farwatch
tiers.description: Darkwood, red bindings, and blue steel from a wandering sky trader. An old green carving watches over every distant trail.
tiers.acquisition: Buy at the wandering Airshop for 150 Green Rupees and one Sacred Weave, or craft at an awakened Hero's Tombstone for the same price plus one Silent Princess (memory level 2).
tiers.progressionNote: The Tombstone requires Zelda's Lullaby activation. The independent recipe consumes no previous weapon; its extra flower offsets repeatable crafting versus limited vendor stock.

audio.theme: Light carved-wood bark, blue-steel bolt and a clear green-relic chime.

gunsmithBench.migration: All rifle/ammo crafting uses this station. Existing vendor sales remain. Identical Skyglass routes merge at their already accessible memory level 1.
